title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the feasibility of installing Toronto-Style Barriers on City streets in-house.
text:
[Council File 26-1424]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT relative to the feasibility of installing Toronto-Style Barriers on City streets in-house.
Recommendation for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hutt – Hernandez):
INSTRUCT the Los Angeles Department of Transportation (LADOT) to report back on the resources required to enable the LADOT to install Toronto Style Barriers in-house.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Motion asking whether the City can install Toronto-style barriers on City streets using its own crews.
